integrity: Analytical phase-language identity and cyclic-run counting establish universal statements; exact-rational finite tests supply supplementary reproducible checks. Independent scientific validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Uniformly recurrent binary pattern Sturmian base and an independently colored constant-marker skeleton are required. No conclusions for overlapping alphabets, several nonconstant residues, or arbitrary nonrecurrent bases. Finite checks do not prove infinite cases. Priority risk from specialized earlier word-combinatorics literature remains.
title: Exact maximal-pattern complexity of periodic-marker extensions of pattern Sturmian words
